_comment: Do NOT add a source here without first checking its terms of use permit automated fetching (many news sites' ToS forbid it even via a public RSS feed) and that WEBLACK has the right relationship to reuse/reference its content. WWD's own RSS feeds were checked and rejected for this project (https://wwd.com/rss-feeds/ redirects to tollbit.wwd.com, which returns 402 Payment Required — a paid-licensing gate specifically for automated/AI access). New entries should start with "enabled": false until a human has reviewed a dry-run of them.
